blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Alex Eala hosted a last-minute open practice on Wednesday night on the eve of her main draw debut at the Singapore Open. Eala practiced in front of her fans under the guidance of Spanish coach Sandro Viaene at Court 1. The training session came after many of Alex Eala’s fans had bought tickets for tonight’s session, hoping to catch her play. It was only Tuesday night that her match was announced for Thursday.
